page_title: EIN 2-1 MON | Eintracht Frankfurt v B. Monchengladbach 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Florian Badstubner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' 2 - 1 Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
90+6' Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Eintracht Frankfurt.

90+5' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) dribbles into the box, but Moritz Nicolas is quick enough to come off his line and stop him. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

90+3' 1 - 1 Niels Nkounkou showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 1:1.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A substitution has been made. Franck Honorat goes off and Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
90' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Nathan Ngoumou.
88' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
83' That will be all from Tuta who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Ansgar Knauff and he is replaced by Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt).
79' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
77' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Alassane Plea.
77' Substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Philipp Max.
77' Substitution. Mario Gotze will be replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' Rocco Reitz will be replaced by Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach).
77' A dangerous looking corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared to safety by the defence.
76' The attendance for today's match is 58000.
74' The game is interrupted now, Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

74' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.
73' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
71' What was William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
71' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Moritz Nicolas to dive and make a save.
69' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.

69' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
69' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

69' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.

67' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
67' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
66' The free kick is taken by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt), but ball is cleared. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner kick.
65' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for a foul. Florian Badstubner had a clear view and blows his whistle.
63' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Robin Hack will be replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).

61' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
60' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Junior Dina Ebimbe.

55' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and the score remained the same.
52' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
51' Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Some neat passing and movement from Eintracht Frankfurt as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
43' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared away by the defence.

43' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.

41' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

37' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
35' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
35' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

34' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Kevin Trapp has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.

27' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 0:1.
27' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
27' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
24' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

23' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
23' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
20' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
15' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) heads on.
12' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
12' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt). The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
6' Florian Badstubner couldn't ignore the rough tackle by William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) and blew his whistle. B. Monchengladbach are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is adjudged offside.
2' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner will referee today's match.
